basic_profile.bio: I'm a lifelong RC hobbyist based in Nashville, Tennessee. I've been tinkering with RC cars since I was a kid and have a collection that includes everything from vintage models to the latest high-performance rigs. I work as a mechanical engineer, which dovetails nicely with my hobby. When I'm not at the track or in my workshop, you can find me hiking with my wife and two dogs or playing the latest Halo game. I'm usually online in the evenings and weekends, especially during race season. I dislike low-quality gear and appreciate discussions that help elevate the community's knowledge.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Middle Tennessee State University (MTSU) and have over two decades of hands-on experience with RC cars. My expertise is largely self-taught, complemented by my educational background, and I stay updated through forums, YouTube tutorials, and attending RC events.
